properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure OpenAI: No Public Network Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure OpenAI (Cognitive Services) accounts with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Azure OpenAI endpoints processing federal data must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public network access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized data exposure and prompt injection from untrusted networks.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Azure OpenAI with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
